name: Toranomon
tagline: Toranomon in 1 minute and Roppongi in 5 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥160,000 to ¥170,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, where Tokyo Metro run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 11 minutes to Otemachi, 18 minutes to Shinjuku, 13 minutes to Shibuya and 14 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. The station stands 5.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 20.5 m. The land around the station rises and falls sharply.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 5.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 4.2 m to 24.7 m, a difference of 20.5 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 1 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 25 clinics and 19 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 虎の門病院, about 6 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 東京慈恵会医科大学附属病院, about 11 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. Tokyo Metro Ginza Line run through it. Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line also call here. Both lines are run by Tokyo Metro, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line runs at 163% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 三ノ輪→入谷, which this station is not on. Tokyo Metro Ginza Line runs at 153%. Its busiest stretch is 赤坂見附→溜池山王, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 1K ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. 1LDK ¥420,000 to ¥430,000 and 2LDK ¥540,000 to ¥550,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the highest in the 23 wards. a small projected flood depth and plenty of places to eat out pushes the figure up. On the other side, a climb from the station to much of the housing and little daily shopping within walking distance holds it down. For One room, 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Kasumigaseki is ahead on the number of lines, but Toranomon is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Toranomon. It reaches Otemachi 6 minutes sooner than Toranomon.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Toranomon, but Uchisaiwaicho is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Toranomon. It reaches Otemachi 7 minutes sooner than Toranomon. One-room rents run about ¥15,000 higher.

noiseSources: 桜田通り (a main road) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
環二通り (a main road) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: The ground around the station rises and falls sharply, and living above or below the slope changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 4 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 9 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.

leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
